# What should you charge for UGC videos?

> Free UGC rate calculator: price your videos plus paid-ad usage rights, whitelisting, exclusivity, raw footage and rush fees. Get a quote range, a walk-away floor and a message to send the brand. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
